title: In situ composite solid electrolyte interphases enabling dendrite-free sodium metal batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00307E, Paper
Jie Huang, Congyu He, Yulong Sun, Xiaoming Xu, Zheyuan Liu, Chengkai Yang
Artificial SEI with NaF/Na2S ensures high ionic conductivity, while organic amide groups regulate Na+ flux via polar adsorption, enhancing sodium metal anode stability.
